anti_overlap: Focuses on tractability; fd-world-systems-coupling-dynamics focuses on feedback loops; fd-world-systems-periphery-asymmetry focuses on structural asymmetry
decision_lens: Every sub-system added multiplies the state space. 8 domains × 5 sub-systems × 221 countries = 8,840 state dimensions before any sub-system has internal structure. The taxonomy must specify what is computed per-country vs. globally, what ticks at what rate, and what the implementation ordering is — or it is a wish list, not an architecture.
focus: Tractability: state space, temporal scales, calibration, and implementation ordering
name: fd-abm-computational-architecture
persona: Computational social scientist who has built large-scale agent-based models (100K+ agents, 50+ parameters). Knows the difference between a taxonomy that produces a beautiful diagram and one that can actually be simulated in finite time with finite memory.
review_areas: Whether the state space is tractable: 8 domains × 5 sub-systems × 221 countries × internal parameters per sub-system
Whether temporal resolution is specified per domain (financial markets = sub-hourly, demographics = annual, climate = decadal)
Whether the taxonomy specifies an implementation ordering that allows partial simulation (which domains can run without others?)
Whether calibration requirements are acknowledged — each sub-system needs country-specific initial conditions and validation data
Whether the relationship between the new domain architecture and the existing 7-pillar + 13-pressure system is specified (replace? augment? layer above?)

severity_examples.condition: The draft lists 'Open Questions' about pressure integration but provides no answer
severity_examples.scenario: No specification of how domains relate to existing pillar/pressure system — two competing architectures with no migration path

severity_examples.condition: No tiering of countries by complexity (full model for 20, simplified for 200)
severity_examples.scenario: All 40 sub-systems assumed to require per-country state for 221 countries, producing ~9000 state variables before parameterization
No implementation ordering — teams cannot build Domain 4 (Information) until Domain 3 (Governance) exists, but this dependency is not documented

success_hints: The taxonomy should include a 'computational budget' section or acknowledge that not all sub-systems operate at the same fidelity for all countries.
task_context: Reviewing civilizational taxonomy for a Rust-based simulation already running 80 agents across 10 countries
